Computer vision for stores: footfall, queues, shelves

Uses your existing cameras to count visitors, queues at the tills and empty shelves, and alerts managers in Telegram. An MVP in 6–10 weeks, from UZS 96 mln; the full version in 14–26 weeks.

Estimate it for your business

What you get

What the MVP includes
  • Pilot in one store
  • Footfall and queue length from 2–6 IP cameras
  • Alerts in Telegram
  • Daily report
  • Video processed on site with no faces stored
What the full version adds
  • Chain rollout
  • Empty-shelf detection
  • Heatmaps
  • Conversion (visitors against POS receipts)
  • Staff presence at counters
  • Central dashboard
Please note

Works with common IP cameras. A small processing box per store is hardware and is quoted separately.

  • Sample data: questions, documents or chats
  • Answer rules and topics to avoid
  • A person who checks the results
